name: Raul Ruiz

items.text: In October 2012, Ruiz's opponent Mary Bono Mack's campaign attacked him over a 1997 arrest at a Thanksgiving protest in Plymouth, Massachusetts. The charges were dropped. The campaign also released audio it said showed him reading a letter supporting Leonard Peltier. His campaign said he didn't recall it and didn't support Peltier. He won.
items.why: This is a campaign attack over 1990s protest activity before he held office; the charges were dropped, no official finding exists, and nothing shows abuse of office or lying about his record (criteria 5 and 6).

for_review: The owner-site search (Ruiz with alexjoneslive.com, stewpeters.com, ryandawson.org and infowars.com) returned nothing about Ruiz, so nothing is attributed to those sites. I did not read the original Desert Sun or Press-Enterprise articles or hear the 1999 audio. ICT reports that the Ruiz campaign did not deny the audio's authenticity and said that, if he read the letter, he did not believe what he was reading. His spokesman's 'did not recall' line is paraphrased there. The page that Item 1 came from is Wikipedia, which was not used as evidence. I did not search for other controversies, because the 4-search limit went to this item and the owner-site check. No other items were added.
